subject: High School Project Management and Designer Selection
overview: The Medford High School Building Committee introduced Left Field as the selected Owner's Project Manager and approved the draft Request for Services to begin the designer selection process.

items.title: Welcome and Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee welcomed new vocational teacher representative Lisa Miller and approved the consent agenda, which included meeting minutes from January 23, 2025, and February 24, 2025.

items.title: Introduction of OPM and Left Field Presentation
items.summary: The committee introduced Left Field as the selected Owner's Project Manager, and the Left Field team gave a presentation outlining their staff capacity, community outreach plan, and preliminary site concepts.

items.title: Review and Approval of Designer Request for Services
items.summary: The committee approved the draft Request for Services to initiate the designer selection process after a motion to lower the upper budget limit to $400 million failed.
